name: com.vegetaalpha.pool
description: Framework-agnostic pooling core (Register/GetObj/ReleaseObj/DestroyPool). PoolSystem takes any ISpawner — no DI framework required by default; use Pool.GetObj<T>() for static-style calls, or construct/inject PoolSystem yourself. Needs a prefab supplier to feed Register(): SO_AllPoolData (included, works out of the box via ApplyTo(pool)) is the built-in one — import a Sample for other supply/spawn mechanisms (VContainer, Addressables).

samples.description: ISpawner backed by VContainer's IObjectResolver.Instantiate — requires jp.hadashikick.vcontainer installed.
Minimal example: resolve a prefab by Addressable key, then Register it into a PoolSystem the normal synchronous way — requires com.unity.addressables installed. Adapt to your project's config shape.
